2/2026: Most of my trading has been happening during the weekend. Please keep this in mind when emailing me!

Hello! You can call me Twigs! :)

  • Started trading: Sep 1, 2024
  • When open, I tend to reply within a few days! (I try to reply to every email I get, but patience is greatly appreciated. Please send a follow up after a week if I haven't responded by then!)
  • I'm very happy and open to tracking any Legally Blonde audios! Send me a message on Discord :)
Extra Info

for my own peace of mind

  • I prefer smaller scale trades (3-5 videos or equivalent is perfect), but I'm happy to do large ones as well. Don’t be afraid to ask!
  • Any merged VOBs will be traded with their original format, but videos with multiple release formats will generally be considered a 1:1 ratio per format. These are noted as such in my trader notes
  • I love having a conversation throughout the trade! If nothing else, tell me about your favourite show :)
  • My links will stay active for a week unless you tell me you need more time. I’ll remind you when I send them over!
  • Sizes are listed from my Mac, which is why file sizes are slightly larger
  • Anything without a format has recently been added to my collection. These will be updated asap!
  • Audios are all listed with the amount of tracks I have, as well as non-DVD videos with multiple files (ex: the recording is split between two acts). Without the given indicator, you can assume there is only one file for the performance. Audios will generally still have a "x1" in this case to minimize confusion
